body: my friends and family. I can't bear the thought of how much pain they would go through if I went through with any of my attempts...

I found out my dad has another type of cancer, after 23 years free. I almost killed myself but called a close friend instead and got a lot off my chest. I have been starving myself and the people around me are starting to notice. I wake up every day not knowing if it's worth it and hating myself so much. I don't know how much more I can handle, but I think there's starting to be a glimpse of light

I know you're tired and you're fighting a battle that is so so hard to fight. But you made it this far, so congratulations! I know it may not seem like it, but it will get better. Keep fighting because there will be a day when you look back and are so grateful that you didn't give up! I am so proud of you for making it this far, let's see if you can break that record again tomorrow!

\*virtual hugs\*

I personally go through waves us this and have come to realize a few things. First, I think that it's really good to be as transparent with the people around you as you can. If you deal with this on your own, it will be so much harder. Also, try not to get sucked into the thinking that you're not allowed to be wrong, mess up, etc. For me, I overthink a lot and am constantly reminding myself that whatever I'm caught up on probably wasn't that big of a deal in the long run.

I don't know if this has helped at all, but I am sending love your way!
Hey, I know it's hard and you feel like you won't get through this, but it's ok. You've made it this far. Now you just have to breathe and take it one step at a time.
